description: `<Teleport to="body">` mounts its one element at the end of `body` once the component has mounted: the server renders none of it, its text follows the component's state, and a click inside it updates what the component shows in place.
requires: Every test reads what the component teleports, which mounts in the browser once the component has mounted: Astro, which runs nothing there, renders none of it (ADR-0098).
